name: bounded retry-controller graph checker
material_outcome: PASS iff the finite transition graph has explicit defined targets, no mutation-state transient self/busy cycles, correct rate-limit/reconstruction routing, and finite normal/reuse/no-op witness paths to terminal states.
scope: Declarative finite-state controller behavior only; not wall-clock, network, service implementation or arbitrary program execution.

checks.property: every string transition target is a defined state
terminal states have no outgoing transitions
for each mutation state, any on_409/on_403_or_429/on_interruption target is not a mutation state
no mutation state has a transient/error self-loop
RATE_LIMIT_WAIT.resume equals RECONSTRUCT and manual_rescue is false
witness reuse path through object/root 409 fetch-and-compare equal branches reaches DONE after successful publish/readback

decision_rule: PASS iff G1-G10 all pass. Report exact failed ids otherwise.
zero_dependency_note: The graph is small and fully represented in repository text, so bounded traversal/comparison is the material checker; no hosted build runner, Codespaces, external compute service or manual step is part of the route.
